description: Hand-labelled funder names for issue #36, used by tests/test_funder_matching.py to measure _is_industry_funder(). Sampled live from CrossRef funder[].name and PubMed <Grant><Agency> by scripts/sample_funder_names.py on 2026-07-30.
labelling_scope: Not every sampled name is labelled. The labelled subset is the union of: (a) every name flagged by either the old substring matcher or the new one — unflagged names cannot contribute false positives, so this is what bounds precision; (b) every name carrying no public-sector cue word, reviewed in full, which is where a missed company would hide; and (c) a reproducible 60-name sample of the cue-bearing remainder (random.Random(36)), which found no industry funder and so bounds how much recall the cue filter could be hiding.

labels.not_industry: Government, university, hospital, charity, or other public-sector funder.
labels.ambiguous: Genuinely undecidable from the string alone. Excluded from the metrics, kept with a reason rather than dropped.
